basis.statement: Every entry states a breach of the group charter and commits to its evidence.

dueProcess.appeal: The manager reviews objections. A dispute venue may be named in the basis document.
dueProcess.effectDuringObjection: An objection does not delay or lift an entry. The manager may suspend the entry while it reviews.
dueProcess.notice: An entry is on record for the notice period before it has effect.
dueProcess.objection: Anyone may record an objection to an entry; the listed side is expected to do so within the notice period.

management.authority: A single account acting on the decisions of the group
management.decisionRecord: Each entry names the decision it carries out in its basis document.

purpose.statement: Agent identities the group refuses to admit

subjects.note: An entry names one object. Whether it reaches related objects is decided by whoever adopts the extension list.
